plan.title: Beginner Full Body Strength
plan.description: An introductory 3-day program focusing on the basic squat pattern, hinge pattern, and push pattern movements to build core strength.

workouts.title: Full Body Workout A
workouts.description: Focuses on the barbell squat, bench press, and horizontal pulling to build baseline strength.

workouts.title: Full Body Workout B
workouts.description: Focuses on the hinge pattern with Romanian deadlifts, overhead pressing, and vertical pulling.

workouts.title: Full Body Workout C
workouts.description: Returns to the squat pattern, with bodyweight pushing and machine pulling for varied stimulus.

exercises.name: Barbell Squat
exercises.description: The foundational lower body movement for building core strength and leg mass.
exercises.instruction: Place the barbell on your upper back. Squat down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then drive through your heels to stand up.

exercises.name: Flat Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instruction: Lie flat on the bench, unrack the bar, lower it to your chest and press back up.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.description: A heavy compound horizontal pulling exercise that builds mass in the upper and middle back.
exercises.instruction: Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor. Grab the barbell and pull it towards your lower ribcage. Lower the weight under control.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: A core isometric exercise that strengthens the abdominals.
exercises.instruction: Start in a push-up position. Hold the position, keeping abs tight.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: A fundamental hinge movement focusing on hamstrings and glutes.
exercises.instruction: Hold the barbell at hip height. Push your hips back while lowering the bar down your legs. Feel the stretch in your hamstrings and return to the start.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: A vertical press focusing on the shoulders and arm strength.
exercises.instruction: Sit or stand with dumbbells at shoulder height. Press the weights upward until arms are straight. Lower slowly back to the start.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: A vertical pulling exercise for developing back width.
exercises.instruction: Grip the bar wider than your shoulders. Pull the bar down to your upper chest while arching your back slightly. Slowly return the bar to the top.

exercises.name: Standard Push-Up
exercises.description: A fundamental bodyweight exercise that builds chest, shoulder, and tricep strength.
exercises.instruction: Start in a high plank position. Lower your body until your chest is just above the floor. Push back up to the starting position.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.description: A horizontal pull focusing on the middle back.
exercises.instruction: Sit with your feet on the pads, knees slightly bent. Pull the handle toward your abdomen. Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then extend your arms back.
